description: This file is a shell script that provides command-line interface functionalities for managing git submodules, such as adding, initializing, updating, listing status, and configuring submodules. It contains functions that parse command-line arguments, execute git commands with various options, and dispatch commands based on user input.

methods.name: cmd_add
methods.description: Adds a new submodule to the working tree, .gitmodules, and the index, with various options for branch, force, name, reference, dissociate, depth, etc.

methods.name: cmd_foreach
methods.description: Executes a command sequence in each checked out submodule, optionally recursively.

methods.name: cmd_init
methods.description: Registers submodules in the .git/config, initializing submodule configurations.

methods.name: cmd_deinit
methods.description: Unregisters submodules from the .git/config and removes their work trees.

methods.name: cmd_update
methods.description: Updates each submodule path to the correct revision, using clone and checkout as needed, with multiple options for fetch, rebase, merge, depth, jobs, etc.

methods.name: cmd_summary
methods.description: Shows commit summaries for submodules in index or working tree, with options for cached status and limits.

methods.name: cmd_status
methods.description: Lists all submodules, indicating their status (not initialized, different revision checked out, cached), optionally recursively.

methods.name: cmd_sync
methods.description: Syncs remote URLs for submodules to match .gitmodules.

methods.name: cmd_absorbgitdirs
methods.description: Handles absorbing git directories for submodules.
